mapper.select:
SELECT keshi name, value
,rate ,rank
,sum
FROM ( SELECT s.value, s.keshi, s.rate, @paixu := @paixu + 1,@incrnum := CASE WHEN @rowtotal = s.value THEN @incrnum WHEN @rowtotal := s.value THEN @paixu END rank, s.sum FROM (SELECT keshi,value,rate,sum FROM data_info WHERE date LIKE CONCAT(#{date},'%') AND type = #{type} ORDER BY value DESC) AS s, (SELECT @paixu := 0 ,@rowtotal := NULL ,@incrnum := 0)r ) w
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_info (date,keshi,value,rate,sum,type) ( SELECT date, keshi, SUM(VALUE) value, ROUND((SUM(VALUE) / b.t) * 100, 2) rate, b.t sum, type FROM dabao_tuiyao_source a, ( SELECT SUM(VALUE) t FROM dabao_tuiyao_source WHERE date LIKE CONCAT(#{date},'%') AND type = #{type} ) b WHERE date LIKE CONCAT(#{date},'%') AND type = #{type} GROUP BY keshi HAVING SUM(VALUE) != 0 )

INSERT INTO data_info (date,keshi,value,rate,sum,type) ( SELECT date, keshi, COUNT(keshi) VALUE , ROUND((COUNT(keshi) / b.t) * 100, 2) rate, b.t sum, 'yizhu' type FROM yizhu_source a, ( SELECT COUNT(keshi) t FROM yizhu_source WHERE date like CONCAT(#{date},'%') ) b WHERE date like CONCAT(#{date},'%') GROUP BY keshi )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM data_info WHERE date like CONCAT(#{date},'%') AND type = #{type};
